data.summary:
Only a **WARPHEAD** can take this. You can use it during your opponent's Command phase: pick an enemy unit up to 18" from this model and visible to it, and roll a D6:

- a 1: this model's unit takes D3 mortal wounds
- a 2+: the enemy unit becomes confrazzled until your opponent's next Command phase

A confrazzled unit gets -2 to its Battle-shock and Leadership tests.
